name: Samadhi Pada
summary: Samadhi Pada defines yoga and describes the nature of samadhi, the obstacles to achieving it, and the means to overcome them.

name: Sadhana Pada
summary: Sadhana Pada explains the practice of Kriya Yoga and Ashtanga Yoga (the eight-limbed path) and its first five stages.

name: Vibhuti Pada
summary: Vibhuti Pada describes the inner three limbs of Yoga (Dharana, Dhyana, Samadhi) and the spiritual powers (vibhutis) that arise from samyama.

name: Kaivalya Pada
summary: Kaivalya Pada discusses the nature of liberation (kaivalya), the mind, and the absolute reality of consciousness (purusha).
